prompt: clang-cl /Zp no value struct packing behavior
answer:
In `clang-cl`, `/Zp` with no value sets the default maximum struct packing alignment to **1 byte**—equivalent to `/Zp1`:

> `/Zp Set the default maximum struct packing alignment to 1`  
> `/Zp<value> Specify the default maximum struct packing alignment`  
> — [Clang Users Manual](https://chromium.googlesource.com/native_client/nacl-llvm-project-v10/+/058c5dfc78cd1a1a6075bba9799e63f3ec871c0d/clang/docs/UsersManual.rst#10)

Clang describes `/Zp` as controlling the default maximum alignment of records, analogous to GCC’s `-fpack-struct`.
